scope: The operating Robert C. Byrd Green Bank Telescope, its circular azimuth track and its supporting steel frame.

originalReview.notes: The public-domain Qualla photo exactly matches the sole native Commons upload. Its first transfer record names the original photographer and declares the author release. The original English Wikipedia upload event confirms the same named account, timestamp and caption for File:GBT.png. The image documents the back of the dish, the outer feed support, its small terminal reflector and the wide braced base.
